verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for a realtime agent platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents scoped or least-privilege API keys, tokens, or permission grants for an agent. The nearby items cover other things: overriding provider API keys (docs-35), running inference without keys (docs-3), and TURN server authentication (docs-11). None of these is the ability to issue narrowly scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
